quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova marks 10 years of SF-free innovation with launch (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GE Vernova launched its F35g 170 kV SF6-free gas-insulated switchgear (g3 technology, GRiDEA portfolio) at CIGRE Paris 2026; it is manufactured in Europe, available for order following the launch, digital-native and designed to meet IEC and IEEE requirements. It completes GE Vernova's SF6-free GIS range for transmission grids at 72.5 kV, 145 kV, 170 kV, 245 kV and 420 kV.
quarterly_data.figure: 170 kV GIS available for order; SF6-free range 72.5 kV to 420 kV
